title: Mouse Perfusion with Dye, DAPI Staining, and Slide Preparation
author: Boaz Mohar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.59jg94n
materials: Float sections in cell culture plate 24 well Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) (Single section per well) with each well filled with 500 µL, 1x PBS (Label plate and wrap with aluminum foil)
Select desired sections and remove PBS from wells.
Allow sections to dry for at least 02:00:00

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of DMSO (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #D2650) to 100nmol of lyophilized dye.
Pipette up and down ~20 times.
Mix further using a vortex machine to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the fixative solution for the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1M PB.
Add 50-100 ul of 1mM dye stock to 50 mL of 4% PFA in 0.1M PB per mouse.

steps.title: Set Up Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the fume hood and perfusion pump.

substeps.instruction: Set up dissection tray (VWR 470006-956), Peristaltic pump-102R (Watson-Marlow 013.7101.000), Surgical Scissors (Fine Science tools 14090-09), and Forceps (Fine Science tools 11223-20).
Attach a Surflo winged infusion set 21G 3/4 (Terumo TER 3SV-21BLK) to the pump tubing.
Flush tubing with ~20 mL of 1x PBS (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP24384) to clear previous solutions.
Place the animal in a container on a raised platform (e.g., square slides box lid or styrofoam from 50ml tube packaging) and cover.
Pour 5 mL of isoflurane (1-3% Patterson Veterinary Catalog #07-893-1389) down the side of the container, ensuring liquid does not contact the animal's skin.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Perfusion
steps.instruction: Verify anesthesia and expose the heart.

substeps.instruction: Once breathing stops, remove the animal and check for pain response by gently pinching the foot with forceps; ensure no reflexive response.
Place mouse on its back on the dissection tray and pin front paws (and others as needed).
Use scissors to cut parallel to the sternum to open the chest cavity and expose the heart.

steps.title: Perform Perfusion
steps.instruction: Flush the circulatory system with fixative and dye.

substeps.instruction: Insert the winged needle into the right ventricle.
Cut the left atrium.
Start the perfusion pump and flush 50 mL of 4% PFA containing 100 µL of dye at a rate of 7.5ml/min.
Stop the pump once all fixative has been flushed through the animal.
Unpin the mouse and decapitate behind the ears.
Remove fur from the head.
Cut small slits into the skull on either side of the opening where the spinal cord connects to the brain.
Use forceps to peel off the skull cap and scoop out the brain.

steps.title: Post-Fix and Rinse Brain
steps.instruction: Fix and wash the extracted brain tissue.

substeps.instruction: Post-fix the brain in 20 mL of 4% PFA for 16:00:00 at 4 °C.
Rinse 3 times (each for 00:15:00) in 1x PBS (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP24384) at room temperature.

steps.title: Embed Brain in Agarose
steps.instruction: Prepare agarose and embed the brain for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 g Agarose LE (Electron Microscopy Sciences Catalog #87046) into 50 mL of 1x PBS in a 500ml glass bottle with a loose cap.
Heat in microwave for 00:01:20; re-heat at 00:00:10 intervals if not completely dissolved.
Pour agarose into a Peel-A-Way® Embedding Mold (Square - S22, Polysciences 18646A-1) and orient the brain in the mold.
Allow agarose to set for approximately 00:10:00 until firm and slightly cloudy.

steps.title: Section Brain
steps.instruction: Slice the brain using a vibratome.

substeps.instruction: Prepare VT 1200s Vibratome (Leica 1491200S001) with a Silver blue double edge razor blade (Gillette Amazon Catalog #884718268996).
Set Amplitude to 1.00mm, Speed to .70mm/s, and Feed (thickness) to 100um.
Fill the buffer tray with 300 mL of 1x PBS.

steps.title: DAPI Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the brain sections with DAPI.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DAPI stain by adding 2.1 µL DAPI stock (Thermo Scientific Catalog #D1306) to 50 mL of 1x PBS.
Add 500 µL of DAPI stain per well and incubate for 02:00:00.
Rinse 2 times (each for 00:05:00) with 500 µL of 1x PBS.

steps.title: Mount and Seal Slides
steps.instruction: Mount sections and apply mounting medium.

substeps.instruction: Mount sections on Superfrost Plus Microscope Slides (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #4951PLUS4).
Rehydrate slides in 250 mL of 1x PBS for 00:30:00.
Cover-slip slides with 130 µL of VECTASHIELD® Hardset™ Antifade Mounting Medium (Vector Laboratories Catalog #H-1400) and allow to dry for 12:00:00.
